facebook.caption:
Walked right past this beach the first time. Don't be me.

Ong Lang beach sits north of the resort strip and most tourists never make the turn. 755 reviews in and it still feels like you have the sand to yourself most mornings.

4.1 stars. Rocky coves, calm water, local fishing boats still working the shoreline. No beach club noise.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Bare feet. Zero umbrellas. Just you and the South China Sea at Ong Lang beach. This is what Phu Quoc looked like before the resorts arrived. 4.1 stars and still this quiet.
